property_summary: For any player who locks in a guess at block B, a settle call at the same block B (before any block advance) must revert, and only after block.number > B may settle succeed; the mutant removes this timing guard, so settle can succeed in the same block as lockInGuess.
change_summary: Replace the require(block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block) timing guard with a require that only enforces non-zero block, changing when settle can succeed.
